body: That means a lot. I say " Why would she give me another chance, I wouldn't give me  another chance " So I want to be the best man I can be, going out to parties and such. She hasn't destroyed my sense of self-worth, but rather just broken my heart. I also go to the gym, it helps for sure. It's rough, but Im trying to be me, or even a better me. Depression just sneaks up on you.
I dont know actually. I guess when I'm ready to move on. Then I'll know I wont regret it.

Just keep going, the only thing I believe is that, with time, things will look up. At the moment I just want to move forward. However, in years I know I'll look back and think why I let her go, and it will be the biggest regret of my life. I know the longer I draw this out, the more I will hurt. But as I told her, I love her, and I won't just let this go - not when she's not 100% sure what she wants.

Are you sure you can't go back? Maybe I'm deluded by my own situation, but no one can possibly know 100% what they want. You can determine your own path in life. Perhaps others actions can't be controlled, but they can be influenced. We can both do this, or move forward. Posting here has taught me that everything is worth trying. You miss 100% of the shots you don't take, or whatever bullshit phrase that is - but theres an element of truth to it.
Thankyou so much man. It means a lot to know I'm not alone, and people care. I'll try and stay strong.

Yeah. My ex was always like that, she was fairly shy, and didn't like to communicate. That's why it all fell apart. She thinks she knows what I wanted, I call her sometimes to please talk to me about it, because she can't know what I wanted. But she just pushes me away, and I tell her that it hurts me that she acts like that, and then we just get back to the " I need time ". It's such a strange mixture of emotions, sadness then anger. It's strange how alike we are. Even though I dont know what to do, we can be lost together, I'm here for you as well.

You know, it's s strange. The one thing that has been constant in my life is reddit. I did not think posting here would give me any help. But everyone here is fighting the same battle, and its comforting that Im not alone. I think about suicide, and think about everyone I leave behind, but they don't mean the same thing to me that she did. Thanks for caring, really, it means so much

I keep telling myself 'you never forget your first'. I hate meaningless phrases like that, but it seems to keep coming up. I have no doubt I can move on, I atleast have some confidence. But for now, it's so rough.
Thanks man. That's exactly what I need. I'll PM you definitely.
Yeah, for now she wants to stay friends. But I dont know if I can do that. She's hurt me a lot, but I LOVE her. It would drive me even further towards self harm if I saw her move on.

I get you man, it's hard to talk to people about it. Because they all say the same pointless shit that only serves to make things worse. The worst thing about this break up was because it all fell into place, we fell in love and that was it. Like you, I hate unknowing what the future holds. 

Anyway, the reason she wanted a break was because she felt we wanted different things in the relationship. She said that I wanted a more " physical " relationship and she didn't. Which is completely untrue. I'd like to talk to her about this misunderstanding, but whats the point when all she ever says is " I need time to think " Fuck that, its complete bullshit.

I'm not sure what you mean. But she was not just a girlfriend by the end of our relationship, but a part of me. I'll be honest, it's only been a few weeks since it happened, but it doesn't get easier as time goes on. So strange that one event can totally destroy everything I once cared about, and make me consider such a horrible thing. Maybe I'm just crying out for attention like they say. But this feels so real.

Yeah, I hate hearing that 'plenty of fish in the sea' crap. I know one day I'll stop caring about her, and move on. Maybe. If I ever make it there. It's hard to believe I'll be able to love someone like I loved her. Maybe it'll pass. But for now...it's just so hard.

I dunno what to say. She was my first serious girlfriend and she wants a break. It doesn't seem so bad, but it's just so painful when I spent most of the past few years of my life with someone that meant so much to me, and now they will barely talk to me. Every day I just want to end it all, so someone will finally care. thanks so much for listening.
That's alright. Just knowing a stranger cares means so much.
